g.text: DictionaryBuilder — from counts to a frequency-ranked, read-only dictionary
(including words about to be filtered out)
i ↦ position in the sorted Vec
N is the pre-threshold token count.
step 1 still sit in the denominator, so the retained mass
Σ p(w) over the kept words is
min_frequency > 1. The deficit is exactly the OOV mass —
a feature for back-off scoring, a trap if you assume the
frequencies, then sets total_tokens = Σ of the
frequencies — not N_A + N_B. Every log_prob is recomputed against
that new N, so probabilities from a merged dictionary are not
comparable with those of its parents.
